tests.name: e01_generic_function
tests.title: a generic function has a list of types before its parameters; the call infers the types or writes them

tests.name: e02_generic_procedure
tests.title: a generic procedure takes a list of types; the call infers it or writes it

tests.name: e03_generic_method
tests.title: a method has its own list of types, in a generic class or in a plain class

tests.name: e04_generic_process
tests.title: the process of an aspect takes a list of types; apply infers it or writes it; one Eve macro

tests.name: e05_overload_types
tests.title: functions and procedures share a name when the types of their parameters differ

tests.name: e06_overload_count
tests.title: functions and procedures share a name when the number of their parameters differs

tests.name: e07_overload_result
tests.title: functions that differ only by the type of the result: the type expected at the call selects one

tests.name: e08_overload_ambiguous
tests.title: a call that does not fix the type of the result of an overloaded function is ambiguous: compile error

tests.name: e09_overload_defaults
tests.title: a default value can make two signatures match the same call: compile error

tests.name: e10_overload_no_match
tests.title: a call that matches no signature of an overloaded name is a compile error

tests.name: e11_function_procedure_name
tests.title: a function and a procedure never share a name: compile error

tests.name: e12_same_signature
tests.title: two declarations with the same signature are a compile error

tests.name: e13_method_result_or_not
tests.title: a method without a result and one with a result share a name: a statement calls the first, an expression the second

tests.name: e14_generic_lambda
tests.title: a lambda has no list of types: compile error

tests.name: e15_type_not_inferred
tests.title: a type that the arguments do not give must be written at the call: compile error

tests.name: e16_macro_apply
tests.title: an Eve macro: shared declarations, an exclusive aspect and the primary aspect in one file

tests.name: e17_macro_parallel
tests.title: an Eve macro starts its concurrent aspects in a parallel group; a shared class carries the results

tests.name: e18_macro_atomic
tests.title: concurrent aspects of a macro add to a shared atomic variable: the total is exact

tests.name: e19_macro_unsafe_variable
tests.title: a concurrent aspect of a macro can not use a shared variable that is not atomic: compile error

tests.name: e20_macro_unsafe_procedure
tests.title: a concurrent aspect of a macro can not call a shared procedure that changes a plain variable: compile error

tests.name: e21_macro_two_primary
tests.title: a macro has one primary aspect: a second one is a compile error

tests.name: e22_macro_statement
tests.title: a statement outside a declaration is a compile error in a macro

tests.name: e23_generator_for
tests.title: a generator gives its values one at a time to a for loop

tests.name: e24_generator_next
tests.title: a generator object is driven step by step with next(), value, done and close()

tests.name: e25_yield_outside
tests.title: yield in a function is a compile error: only the body of a generator can yield

tests.name: e26_generator_statement
tests.title: a generator called as a statement is a compile error: its values would be lost

tests.name: e27_decimal_scale
tests.title: a Decimal keeps its scale, adds exactly and compares by value

tests.name: e28_instant
tests.title: an Instant prints in the canonical form; a bad text is the error parse

tests.name: e29_secret_masked
tests.title: a Secret is never printed: print and interpolation write ***

tests.name: e30_null_in_plain_field
tests.title: a null for a field that is not optional is a compile error

tests.name: e31_fs_files
tests.title: fs writes, appends, reads lines and reports a missing file with the error code 20

tests.name: e32_csv_write
tests.title: the CSV writer: header, quotes only when needed, null is empty and the empty string is ""

tests.name: e33_csv_read_typed
tests.title: the CSV reader decodes into a record class: Decimal, Instant, null and the empty string

tests.name: e34_csv_bad_row
tests.title: a CSV line with a wrong number of fields is a FormatError when the loop reaches it

tests.name: e35_csv_rejects
tests.title: a read with a rejects output skips the bad lines and writes them in a file, in batches

tests.name: e36_json_lines
tests.title: JSON Lines: the writer text is exact, the reader gives the records back

tests.name: e37_txt_fixed
tests.title: TXT: fixed-length fields, strings left, numbers right, not trimmed; the reader slices by the widths

tests.name: e38_nfc
tests.title: normalize: "nfc" composes e + accent into one code point; by default the text is kept as read

tests.name: e39_table_unknown_key
tests.title: a key that names a field the class does not have is a compile error

tests.name: e40_table_reference_cycle
tests.title: two tables that reference each other are a compile error

tests.name: e41_table_temporary_data
tests.title: temporary is allowed only for the staging database: a table of another connection is a compile error

tests.name: e42_commit_outside_job
tests.title: commit; is allowed only in the do region of a job: a compile error elsewhere

tests.name: e43_update_block_key
tests.title: a key field can not be changed in an update block: a compile error

tests.name: e44_table_read_only_add
tests.title: a record can not be added to a read only table: a compile error

tests.name: e45_job_two_writes
tests.title: a job writes to one connection only: writing to two is a compile error

tests.name: e46_orm_dirty_fields
tests.title: an update writes only the dirty fields: a column changed by direct SQL is not overwritten

tests.name: e47_orm_conflict
tests.title: optimistic locking: an update of a row that changed after it was read is a ConflictError

tests.name: e48_job_rollback
tests.title: rollback; undoes the job: nothing is written, the status is "rolled back", the process goes on

tests.name: e49_job_error_rollback
tests.title: an error in a job rolls the transaction back before recover runs

tests.name: e50_update_block
tests.title: an update block changes several fields of one record without repeating its name

tests.name: e51_update_block_validate
tests.title: validate runs at the end of an update block, with all the fields changed together

tests.name: e52_mapping_version
tests.title: in production the VM trusts db/mappings.json: a schema version that differs is a MappingError, exit code 4

tests.name: e53_commit_checkpoint
tests.title: commit; ends a batch, the checkpoint (in the core database) tells the next job where to start

tests.name: e54_project_init
tests.title: project init <folder> makes a new project with the standard layout (F-TLS-23)

tests.name: e55_project_new_not_empty
tests.title: project new <folder> fails when the folder exists and is not empty; project init does not (F-TLS-23)

tests.name: e56_etl_csv_sqlite_json
tests.title: a small ETL on local storage: data/in/sales.csv is loaded into the SQLite database cache.db, transformed with SQL and written as JSON in data/out

tests.name: e57_overload_generic_plain
tests.title: a plain function whose parameters fit exactly wins over a generic one with the same name

tests.name: e58_generic_constraint
tests.title: a type argument must adopt the trait of its constraint: compile error

tests.name: e59_extension_same_signature
tests.title: an extension method with the signature of a method of the class would replace it: compile error; another signature overloads it: e60

tests.name: e60_extension_overload
tests.title: an extension method with another signature overloads the method of the class

tests.name: e61_macro_needs_primary
tests.title: a file with an aspect and shared declarations but no primary aspect is not a macro: compile error

tests.name: e62_macro_export
tests.title: a macro exports nothing: export is a compile error

tests.name: e63_macro_aspect_scope
tests.title: an aspect of a macro sees the shared declarations and no variable of the primary aspect's process

tests.name: e64_macro_duplicate_name
tests.title: a top-level name declared twice in a macro is a compile error: one scope for the whole file

tests.name: e65_macro_aspect_conflict
tests.title: an aspect of the macro with the name of an aspect file of the project is a compile error

tests.name: e66_generator_lazy
tests.title: a generator is lazy: its body runs only when the caller asks for a value, and an infinite one is closed by break

tests.name: e67_generator_error
tests.title: an error raised in the body ends the generator and is raised in the caller, at the for line

tests.name: e68_generator_value_early
tests.title: reading g.value before the first next() is an error

tests.name: e69_generator_method
tests.title: a generator can be a member of a class; a comprehension collects its values

tests.name: e70_generator_two_results
tests.title: a generator has exactly one result: compile error

tests.name: e71_generator_ref_param
tests.title: a generator has inputs only, by value: an @ parameter is a compile error

tests.name: e72_yield_in_process
tests.title: yield in a process is a compile error: only the body of a generator yields; in a function inside a generator: e104

tests.name: e73_decimal_ops
tests.title: Decimal arithmetic is exact: subtraction, division, negation, remainder, comparison and a whole number on one side

tests.name: e74_decimal_real_mix
tests.title: a Decimal and a Real are never mixed without a conversion: an operand of the wrong type is a compile error

tests.name: e75_instant_forms
tests.title: an Instant keeps a fraction of a second, compares by time, and a date that does not exist is the error parse

tests.name: e76_secret_rules
tests.title: a Secret prints as *** alone, in interpolation and in a collection (data-language.md#secrets); joining it to a text: e103

tests.name: e77_optional_fields
tests.title: a field with ? holds null; a plain field never does; null is tested before use

tests.name: e78_null_constructor_argument
tests.title: null as an argument for a member that is not optional is a compile error, in a call of the class too

tests.name: e79_secret_missing
tests.title: a secret that the machine does not have is the error key, code 11 (data-language.md#secrets)

tests.name: e80_csv_options
tests.title: CSV options: another separator, no header, a BOM, CRLF line ends, and columns: renames the columns of the file (data-types.md)

tests.name: e81_json_array
tests.title: JSON: an array of objects is written one object per line and read back; a missing key is null; a number keeps its scale

tests.name: e82_txt_rules
tests.title: TXT: a value longer than its width is a FormatError, overflow: "cut" cuts it; a field of spaces is null for T? (data-types.md)

tests.name: e83_encodings
tests.title: encodings: windows-1252 and a UTF-16 BOM are decoded to text; invalid UTF-8 is an error with its place, or replaced (data-types.md)

tests.name: e84_fs_functions
tests.title: fs: read!, size!, list!, move, remove, make_dir, and the path functions and the operator / (data-language.md#files-and-paths)

tests.name: e85_rejects_limit
tests.title: max_rejects: the reject after the limit is an error of the read; the rejects file has source, line, column, text and reason (data-types.md)

tests.name: e86_stream_methods
tests.title: a stream has all(), count(), close() and next() with the protocol of a generator (next() gives True and s.value); leaving the loop with break writes the rejects of what was read (data-types.md)

tests.name: e87_orm_reads
tests.title: reading through a table: find! gives the record or null, a second find! gives the same record, where! tracks, scan! does not (database.md)

tests.name: e88_orm_write_methods
tests.title: status, a field set back to its value, remove, refresh after a direct write, add and flush, detach (database.md)

tests.name: e89_orm_reference_order
tests.title: a flush writes inserts in the order of the references and deletes in the reverse order, whatever the order of the program (database.md)

tests.name: e90_orm_validate_add
tests.title: validate runs before every write: an invalid record fails the job at the flush and nothing is written (database.md, validation)

tests.name: e91_orm_load
tests.title: load! writes many rows at once, not tracked: "insert" adds, "upsert" inserts the new keys and updates the others (database.md)

tests.name: e92_orm_temporary
tests.title: a temporary table in the staging database is made by the VM from the class at its first use (database.md, the table declaration)

tests.name: e93_orm_outside_job
tests.title: outside a job a record that is added or changed is written and committed at once, one statement at a time (database.md, transactions)

tests.name: e94_orm_retry_conflict
tests.title: a conflict fails the job and rolls it back; retry runs the job again from its declarations and reads the row fresh (database.md)

tests.name: e95_test1
tests.title: a machine that listens on IPC only: no web, commands run through the socket (F-NET-02, spec/library/machine.md)

tests.name: e95_test2
tests.title: a machine that serves HTTP only: pages and scripts over the web port (F-NET-02, spec/library/machine.md)

tests.name: e95_test3
tests.title: a machine that listens on IPC and serves HTTP: the CLI uses IPC, a remote uses HTTP (F-NET-02, spec/library/machine.md)

tests.name: e95_test4
tests.title: the machine API over HTTP: vm.* and the first names, -32601, the web door; started and stopped as the UI part

tests.name: e95_test5
tests.title: the stdio door: a machine of one client on its standard input and output (evetx, ssh host eve --stdio)

tests.name: e95_web_hello
tests.title: the Eve web server answers with a page: Hello World, This is Eve (F-NET-02, first step)

tests.name: e96_sql_function
tests.title: sql function: an Eve function that SQLite calls from SQL, registered on every connection

tests.name: e97_sql_function_error
tests.title: an error in a sql function stops the query: the statement raises $err_sql with the message of the error

tests.name: e98_sql_function_null
tests.title: SQL NULL maps only to a nullable type: a NULL for a parameter of type String stops the query with $err_sql

tests.name: e99_sql_function_bang
tests.title: a sql function is deterministic: its name can not end with !

tests.name: e100_sql_function_type
tests.title: the parameters and the result of a sql function have SQL types: a List is refused

tests.name: e101_sql_function_overload
tests.title: a sql function can not be overloaded: SQL finds a function by its name

tests.name: e102_proc_module
tests.title: Eve stored procedures: a module of proc/ is imported like any module; its sql function is registered on the connection

tests.name: e102_test1
tests.title: eve db proc list: the modules of proc/ with the hash of their source, and their exported procedures with signatures

tests.name: e103_secret_join
tests.title: a Secret is not a String: joining it to a text with + is a compile error (data-language.md#secrets)

tests.name: e104_yield_in_nested_function
tests.title: yield in a function declared inside a generator is a compile error: only the body of the generator itself yields

tests.name: e105_decimal_real_convert
tests.title: Decimal and Real are converted explicitly: d.real(), r.decimal(), or by:= to a variable or a type hint of the other kind

tests.name: e106_print_null
tests.title: null is the value and Null its type: print writes null, type() gives Null

tests.name: e107_time_now_bang
tests.title: the clock is not deterministic: its name ends with !, time.now!(); time.now() is refused

tests.name: e108_macro_primary_pipeline
tests.title: a macro: the primary aspect applies a concurrent aspect that starts its own private processes

tests.name: e109_macro_primary_applied
tests.title: in a macro, no aspect applies the primary aspect

tests.name: e110_connection_import
tests.title: import: a method of the connection that loads a file (CSV, TXT, JSON or DBF) as a new table

tests.name: e111_memory_table
tests.title: Memory: a class derived from Memory is a columnar table; a column is named by its field; load and store move data
